blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The rapid advancement of image-to-text extraction systems and large language models (LLMs) poses new challenges for educational assessment by making assignment materials easy to transcribe and solve with minimal human effort. To address this problem, we present AIRRI (Artificial Intelligence Resilient Reading Interface), a framework for generating machine-resistant educational content, a dataset of higher-education assignments for evaluation, and an initial evaluation of the human readability of AIRRI machine-resistant text designs. AIRRI employs two categories of machine-resistance techniques. First, AIRRI applies image transformations including character spacing, word spacing, line spacing, character opacity variation, stripe overlays, and image noise. Second, AIRRI applies decision-based adversarial attacks: RayS, SurFree, and ADBA. We evaluate AIRRI against three image-to-text systems: Tesseract, EasyOCR, and the transformer-based GOT-OCR2 model. Our results show that AIRRI substantially degrades automated text extraction performance. AIRRI increased character error rates for EasyOCR (6.9% to 55.9%), Tesseract (2.3% to 100.0%), and GOT-OCR2 (30.7% to 48.1%). Word error rates increased for EasyOCR (24.9% to 96.7%) and Tesseract (10.7% to 100.0%). Among the evaluated decision-based attacks, ADBA consistently produced the largest degradation in image-to-text performance, while RayS and SurFree produced more moderate reductions. EasyOCR and Tesseract were generally more susceptible to both image-based and adversarial perturbations than the transformer-based GOT-OCR2 model. Our findings suggest that AIRRI can significantly reduce the reliability of image-to-text-to-LLM workflows, increasing the effort required for AI-assisted assignment completion.
blocks.zh: 图像到文本提取系统和大型语言模型的迅速发展,使派任材料易于被转录并用最低限度的人力解决,给教育评估带来了新的挑战。 为了解决这一问题,我们提出了人工智能耐读接口(AIRRI),这是一个生成耐机教育内容的框架,一个用于评价的高等教育任务数据集,以及AIRRI耐机文本设计对人类可读性的初步评价。 AIRRI采用两种类型的机器抵抗技术。 首先,AIRRI应用了图像转换,包括字符间距,字行间距,行间距,字符不透明变异,条纹覆盖,和图像噪音. 第二,非洲空研所采用基于决定的对抗性攻击:RayS、SurFree和亚行。 我们对照三个图像对文本系统来评价AIRI:魔方,EasyOCR,以及基于变压器的GOT-OCR2模型. 我们的结果显示,AIRRI极大地降低了自动文本提取性能. AIRRI提高了EasyOCR(6.9%至55.9%)、魔方(2.3%至100.0%)和GOT-OCR2(30.7%至48.1%)的字符错误率。 EasyOCR(24.9%至96.7%)和宇宙魔方(10.7%至100.0%)的文字出错率上升. 在经过评价的以决策为基础的攻击中,亚银在图像到文字的性能方面一直产生最大的退化,而RayS和SurFree则产生更适度的减少. EasyOCR和宇宙魔方一般比以变压器GOT-OCR2为主的型号更容易受图像和对抗性的扰动. 我们的调查结果表明,AIRI能够大大降低图像到文本到LLM工作流程的可靠性,从而加大AI协助完成任务所需的努力.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Digital text is designed to maximize accessibility [ 30 ] and machine readability [ 36 ] , enabling copying, searching, indexing, and automated processing [ 3 ] . While these properties provide significant usability benefits [ 37 ] , they also make content easily subject to automated extraction. Advances in image-to-text and language-processing systems have made it increasingly possible to rapidly convert on-screen text into machine-readable representations and process it automatically [ 1 , 8 , 26 , 42 ] . As artificial intelligence systems continue to improve, this raises an important question: can educational material remain readable and usable for human learners while becoming more resistant to automated extraction and machine-assisted completion?
blocks.zh: 数字文本旨在最大限度地实现无障碍[30]和机器可读性[36],从而能够复制、搜索、索引和自动处理[3]。 虽然这些属性提供了显著的可用性惠益[37],但也使得内容易于进行自动化提取. 图像对文本和语言处理系统的进展使得越来越有可能迅速将屏幕上的案文转换成机器可读的表示并自动处理[1、8、26、42]。 随着人工智能系统的不断完善,这提出了一个重要的问题:教育材料能否保持可读性,供人类学习者使用,同时对自动提取和机器辅助完成的抗药性增强?

blocks.en: Modern LLMs can generate human-like responses, summarize content, and answer questions [ 6 , 34 ] . Combined with image-to-text extraction systems, they enable educational material to be rapidly converted into machine-readable text and processed through automated workflows. Thus, assignment content can be extracted from screenshots and given to AI systems for question answering, summarization, or assignment completion with minimal effort [ 4 ] . This creates a growing challenge for educators seeking to promote direct student engagement while limiting low-effort AI-assisted workflows.
blocks.zh: 现代LLMS可以产生类似人类的反应,总结内容,回答问题[6,34]. 它们与图像到文本提取系统相结合,使教育材料能够迅速转换成机器可读文本,并通过自动化工作流程处理。 因此,任务内容可以从截图中抽取出来,并提供给AI系统,用于回答问题、归纳或以最小努力完成任务[4]。 这给寻求促进学生直接参与同时限制低效率AI辅助工作流程的教育工作者带来了日益严峻的挑战.

blocks.en: Existing responses to AI-assisted academic misuse frequently focus on behavioral policies [ 41 ] , plagiarism detection, browser restrictions, or later identification of AI-generated work. While these approaches may discourage misuse or identify suspicious outputs after submission, they often do not address how easily students can extract and process educational content through image-to-text and LLM-based workflows. Furthermore, detection-based approaches may become less reliable [ 28 ] as generative models continue to improve and student usage patterns evolve. This motivates exploring preventive approaches that increase the difficulty of automated extraction while preserving the usability of instructional materials.
blocks.zh: 对AI协助的学术误用的现有对策经常侧重于行为政策[41],盗版检测,浏览器限制,或后来识别AI生成的作品. 虽然这些方法可能防止滥用或发现提交后的可疑产出,但往往没有涉及学生如何容易通过图像到文字和基于LLM的工作流程提取和处理教育内容的问题。 此外,随着基因模型的不断改进和学生使用模式的演变,基于检测的方法可能变得不那么可靠[28]。 这促使人们探索预防方法,增加自动化提取的难度,同时保持教学材料的可用性。

blocks.en: To address these challenges, we propose AIRRI (Artificial Intelligence Resilient Reading Interface). A system designed to increase resistance to automated extraction while preserving the readability of educational material for human users. AIRRI transforms assignment and instructional content into a machine-resistant format that impedes image-to-text recognition and downstream automated processing. This increases the difficulty of submitting extracted material directly to LLMs. AIRRI could enable educators to distribute content that remains available to human readers while making low-effort image-to-text and LLM-assisted workflows harder. Rather than eliminating misuse entirely, AIRRI increases the human effort required for such behavior. A student supplying assignment content to an LLM would need to manually transcribe it rather than rely on automated extraction methods. We investigate whether controlled text perturbations can reduce the effectiveness of image-to-text and downstream automated processing while using levels of perturbation to preserve some readability. We evaluate AIRRI across multiple image-to-text systems using real-world educational assignments and quantitative performance metrics to examine the trade-off between machine resistance and the severity of text perturbation.
blocks.zh: 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议采用人工智能耐读界面。 一个旨在增强对自动提取的阻力,同时保留教育材料对人类使用者的可读性. AIRI将任务和教学内容转化为一种抗机器格式,阻碍图像到文本的识别和下游自动化处理. 这增加了将提取的材料直接提交LLMS的难度. AIRRI可以使教育工作者能够向人类读者分发仍然可以使用的内容,同时使低效图像到文本和LLM辅助工作流程更加困难。 非洲空研所没有完全消除滥用现象,反而增加了人们为这种行为付出的努力。 向LLM提供分配内容的学生需要手动转录,而不是依赖自动提取方法。 我们调查受控文本扰动能否降低图像对文本和下游自动化处理的有效性,同时利用扰动程度来保持一些可读性. 我们利用现实世界的教育任务和数量性能衡量标准,在多个图像对文本系统中评价AIRI,以审查机器阻力与文本扰动的严重程度之间的权衡。

blocks.zh: 图1:AIRI管道将教官提供的任务转变为耐机文本,同时保持人的可读性。 图像到文本和LLM系统可以提取未受保护的文本,而AIRI保护的文本则需要人工抄录.

blocks.en: 2 AIRRI Pipeline
blocks.zh: 2架AIRI管道

blocks.en: AIRRI renders educational content as images and applies a combination of typographic, image-level, and adversarial perturbations. We cover AIRRI’s threat model, pipeline architecture, rendering, defense mechanisms, and evaluation.
blocks.zh: AIRI将教育内容作为图像,并采用印刷、图像级别和对抗性扰动的组合。 包括AIRRI的威胁模式、管道结构、渲染、防御机制和评价。

blocks.en: 2.1 Threat Model
blocks.zh: 2.1 威胁模式

blocks.en: AIRRI assumes an adversary who attempts to process educational material through an image-to-text extraction pipeline followed by an LLM with minimal manual effort. The adversary is assumed to have access to modern automated text-extraction systems and may capture assignment content via screenshots or other extraction methods. Unlike traditional adversarial machine learning [ 12 ] , AIRRI does not seek to induce specific misclassifications. Instead, it seeks to degrade automated text extraction while maintaining some usability for human readers.
blocks.zh: AIRRI假设对手试图通过图像到文本的提取管道处理教育材料,然后是最低人工操作的LLM。 假定对手可以使用现代自动文本提取系统,并且可以通过截图或其他提取方法获取任务内容。 与传统的对抗机器学习[12]不同,AIRI并不寻求诱导特定的分类错误. 相反,它寻求降解自动文本提取,同时保持一些对人类阅读器的可用性.

blocks.en: An attack succeeds when an image-to-text system extracts enough information to reconstruct the original text with little or no manual transcription. A defense succeeds when it substantially degrades extraction quality while preserving human readability. AIRRI does not seek to make extraction impossible; instead, it increases the effort required for automated processing and reduces the effectiveness of AI-assisted extraction.
blocks.zh: 当一个图像到文本系统提取足够的信息,以很少或没有手抄本的方式重建原始文本时,攻击成功. 防守如果在保持人类可读性的同时大幅度降低提取质量,则成功. AIRRI并不试图使提取成为不可能;相反,它增加了自动化处理所需的努力,降低了AI辅助提取的有效性.

blocks.en: 2.2 Pipeline Overview
blocks.zh: 2.2 管道概况

blocks.en: Figure 1 shows an overview of the AIRRI pipeline. Given an input assignment or instructional document, AIRRI produces a protected image intended to disrupt automated image-to-text extraction. AIRRI implements three categories of perturbations: typographic, image-level, and adversarial. The effectiveness of these perturbations is evaluated using EasyOCR [ 17 ] , Tesseract [ 29 ] , and GOT-OCR2 [ 44 ] .
blocks.zh: 图1显示AIRI管道概况。 鉴于输入任务或指令性文件,AIRRI生成一个受保护的图像,旨在干扰自动图像到文本提取。 AIRI执行三类扰动:印刷、图像级别和对抗。 这些扰动的效果通过EasyOCR [17],魔方[29],以及GOT-OCR2 [44]来评价.

blocks.en: The AIRRI pipeline has five stages: (1) Input Acquisition , (2) Text Rendering , (3) Perturbation Application , (4) Automated Extraction , and (5) Evaluation . During Stage 1, instructor-provided educational material is the source text. Stage 2 renders the source material to a canvas-based image using fixed rendering parameters. Stage 3 applies the selected perturbation techniques to generate a protected image. Stage 4 evaluates extraction resistance by processing both protected and unprotected images through three image-to-text systems: EasyOCR, Tesseract, and GOT-OCR2, representing traditional and transformer-based extraction architectures. Stage 5 evaluates extraction quality and downstream assignment completion using Character Error Rate (CER), Word Error Rate (WER) [ 18 , 31 ] , and LLM Error Rate (LER).
blocks.zh: AIRI管道分五个阶段:(1) 输入获取,(2) 文本渲染,(3) 扰动应用,(4) 自动提取,(5) 评价。 在第一阶段,教员提供的教材是资料来源。 第2阶段利用固定渲染参数使源材料变成基于画布的图像. 第3阶段应用选定的扰动技术生成受保护的图像. 第四阶段通过EasyOCR,Tefferact,和GOT-OCR2三种图像对保护的和无保护的图像进行处理,评价提取阻力,代表传统和变压器提取架构. 第5阶段利用字符错误率(CER),词错误率(WER)[18,31],以及LLM错误率(LER)来评价提取质量和下游任务完成情况.

blocks.en: 2.3 Text Generation Pipeline
blocks.zh: 2.3 文本生成 管道

blocks.en: AIRRI transforms instructor-provided educational material into a machine-resistant image representation using an HTML canvas rendering pipeline. Input text is rendered using the font Roboto at 16 px with configurable character, word, and line spacing. We selected Roboto because it is the most viewed font on the web per Google Font Analytics [ 13 , 37 ] and is often the sole font studied in related readability research [ 25 , 20 , 21 , 23 ] . Text is rendered with automatic line wrapping to preserve paragraph structure and reading order before exporting as a PNG image. For experimental consistency, all renderings were generated in a web browser at a fixed resolution of 1920 × \times 1080. Clean and protected images were produced from identical source text and rendering settings, differing only through the application of AIRRI perturbations.
blocks.zh: AIRRI利用HTML帆布渲染管道,将教官提供的教材转变为耐机的图像表示。 输入文本使用16 px 的字体Roboto 提供,其字符、字和行间距可配置。 我们选择Roboto是因为这是Google Font Analytics中网络上浏览最多的字体[13,37],并且往往是相关可读性研究中研究的唯一字体[25,20,21,23]. 文本在导出为 PNG 图像之前带有自动行包,以保留段落结构和读取顺序。 为了实验一致性,所有渲染都是在网页浏览器中以1920×\times 1080. 清洁和受保护的图像是从相同的源文本和渲染设置产生的,仅通过应用AIRRI扰动而有所不同。

blocks.en: 2.4 Defense Mechanisms
blocks.zh: 2.4 防卫机制

blocks.en: AIRRI employs three categories of defense mechanisms: typographic perturbations, image-level perturbations, and adversarial perturbations. Typographic perturbations modify the appearance and layout of rendered text, image-level perturbations alter the rendered image, and adversarial perturbations introduce model-targeted modifications intended to reduce extraction accuracy.
blocks.zh: AIRRI使用三类防御机制:印刷扰动、图像层扰动和对抗扰动。 类型扰动修改了渲染文本的外观和布局,图像级扰动修改了渲染图像,对抗性的扰动引入了旨在降低提取精度的针对模型的修改.

blocks.en: 2.4.1 Typographic Perturbations
blocks.zh: 2.4.1 类型干扰

blocks.en: AIRRI applies four configurable typographic perturbation techniques to alter text appearance and reduce image-to-text extraction quality. Our text designs are based on prior readability literature to try and preserve human readability [ 38 , 24 ] . Prior research shows that typographic attributes such as font selection and character/word spacing can influence reading performance and readability [ 7 , 33 , 32 ] . Unless otherwise specified, each perturbation is applied uniformly throughout the rendered document. Figure 2 shows examples of the image-level perturbations used in AIRRI at increasing intensity levels.
blocks.zh: AIRRI应用四种可配置的打字扰动技术来改变文本外观,降低图像到文本的提取质量. 我们的文本设计基于之前的可读性文献,以尝试和保存人类的可读性[38,24]. 先前的研究表明,字体选择和字符/字间距等打字属性可以影响阅读性能和可读性[7,33,32]. 除非另有说明,每次扰动均在所提供的文件中统一适用。 图2显示了在AIRRI中使用的图像层扰动强度不断提高的例子。

blocks.en: During rendering, spacing (character, word, and line) are CSS parameters that map distances to pixels. Thus, changing the appearance and paragraph layout of text [ 3 ] . Character spacing is the the distance between adjacent characters [ 7 , 33 ] . Word spacing is the space between adjacent words [ 3 , 38 ] . Line spacing is the the distance between successive lines of text [ 27 ] .
blocks.zh: 在渲染过程中,间隔(字符,单词,和线)是CSS参数,可以将距离映射到像素. 因此,改变案文的外观和段落布局。 字符间隔是相邻字符之间的距离[7,33]. 字间距是相邻字之间的间距[3,38]. 行间距是文本相继行间距[27].

blocks.en: 2.4.2 Image-Level Perturbations
blocks.zh: 2.4.2 图像层扰动

blocks.zh: 2.4.3 恶意骚扰

blocks.en: We evaluate three black-box adversarial attacks against image-to-text systems. Each attack operates under a hard-label threat model: the attacker observes only the final discrete output of the image-to-text engine (i.e., the recognized text string), not internal confidence scores or gradients.

blocks.en: 2.5 Evaluation Pipeline
blocks.zh: 2.5 评价管道

blocks.en: The AIRRI evaluation pipeline measures automated text extraction performance by comparing extracted text against ground-truth source material. The evaluation process has two stages: automated extraction and extraction scoring.
blocks.zh: AIRI评价管道通过比较所提取的文本与地面真实来源材料,衡量自动文本提取性能。 评价过程分为两个阶段:自动提取和提取评分.

blocks.en: 2.5.1 Automated Extraction
blocks.zh: 2.5.1 自动提取

blocks.en:
AIRRI evaluates machine resistance using three image-to-text systems: Tesseract, EasyOCR, and GOT-OCR2. We selected these systems to represent both traditional image-to-text architectures and modern transformer-based vision-language models.
For each rendered image, all three extraction systems generate an independent text transcription. We evaluate Tesseract using the English language model, page segmentation mode 6, and OCR engine mode 3. We evaluate EasyOCR using its English language model with paragraph-level text aggregation enabled. GOT-OCR2 is evaluated using the publicly available stepfun-ai/GOT-OCR-2.0-hf checkpoint.
blocks.zh:
AIRRI利用三个图像对文本系统来评价机器阻力:魔方,EasyOCR和Got-OCR2. 我们选择了这些系统来代表传统的图像对文本架构和现代变压器的视觉语言模型.
对于每个渲染的图像,所有三个提取系统都会生成独立的文本转录. 我们使用英语模式,页面分区模式6和OCR引擎模式来评价宇宙魔方 3个 我们使用英文模式评价EasyOCR,并启用段落级文本汇总。 GOT-OCR2是通过公开的继发/GOT-OCR-2.0-hf检查站进行评估的。

AIRRI evaluates extraction performance using Character Error Rate (CER) and Word Error Rate (WER), two standard text-recognition metrics. blocks.en: 2.5.3 LLM Performance Evaluation
blocks.zh: 2.5.3 LLM 考绩

blocks.en: While CER and WER quantify extraction quality, AIRRI seeks to disrupt downstream assignment completion using LLMs. To evaluate this effect, we supply an LLM with text extracted by each image-to-text system and use it to complete the assignment. We evaluated downstream LLM performance using ChatGPT through the ChatGPT web interface in Instant mode in July 2026. We conducted each evaluation in a new Temporary Chat to prevent prior conversation context from influencing the response. The raw OCR output was provided without manual correction or preprocessing using the prompt, “Complete the following assignment to the best of your ability using only the information provided. Provide only your final answer, without additional commentary or explanation.” A single inference was performed for each OCR extraction. Because the ChatGPT interface was used rather than the OpenAI API, inference parameters such as temperature, top- p p , and random seed were not user-configurable and therefore were not explicitly controlled.
blocks.zh: 虽然CER和WER量化提取质量,但AIRRI试图利用LLMs干扰下游任务的完成。 为了评估这一效果,我们提供了一个LLM,其中包含每个图像对文本系统提取的文本,并利用它来完成任务. 我们于2026年7月通过Instant模式的ChatGPT网络界面,使用ChatGPT评估下游LM性能. 我们用新的“临时聊天”方式进行了每次评估,以防止先前的对话背景影响回应。 提供原始OCR输出时没有手工纠正,也没有使用“只利用提供的信息尽你所能完成以下任务”的提示进行预处理。 只提供最后答复,不作补充评论或解释。” 对每次OCR提取都进行了单一推断。 因为使用ChatGPT接口而非OpenAI API,所以温度,顶-p,随机种子等推论参数不能使用用户配置,因此没有明确控制.

blocks.en: 2.6 Dataset for Evaluation
blocks.zh: 2.6 评价数据集

blocks.en: Our new evaluation dataset has nine higher-education (HE) assignments collected from instructors at two universities. Five assignments were from a University of Connecticut English instructor and two from a University of Rhode Island History instructor. One English assignment has three essay topics with distinct assignment texts; thus, we created three separate evaluation instances. The final dataset contains seven English assignments and two History assignments. For evaluation, each assignment was rendered as clean and AIRRI-protected images, and CER and WER were computed. Table 1 summarizes the introduced dataset. Evaluation was also performed on open-source datasets of 8th and 12th grade-level reading passages (8-and-12) provided by The Readability Consortium [ 37 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们的新评价数据集有从两所大学的教员那里收集的九项高等教育任务。 5项任务来自康涅狄格大学英语教官,2项来自罗德岛大学历史教官。 一项英文任务有三个论文题目,有不同的任务文本;因此,我们创造了三个单独的评价实例。 最终数据集包含7项英语任务和2项历史任务. 为了评价,每项任务都是作为清洁和受AIRI保护的图像进行的,并计算了CER和WER。 表1汇总了引进的数据集。 还对《可读性联合会》提供的8级和12级读物(8级和12级)的开源数据集进行了评价。

blocks.en: 3 Results
blocks.zh: 3 结果

blocks.en: We evaluate AIRRI’s effectiveness in degrading automated text extraction. We first compare extraction performance on clean and AIRRI-protected documents, then analyze the effects of individual adversarial attacks and extraction systems using CER and WER. Unless otherwise specified, the AIRRI pipeline generated AIRRI-protected documents, including all typographic and image-level perturbations applied simultaneously.
blocks.zh: 校对:Soup 我们首先比较了清洁和AIRI保护的文件中的提取性能,然后用CER和WER分析单个对抗攻击和提取系统的影响. 除非另有说明,AIRI管道生成了AIRI保护的文件,包括同时应用的所有打印和图像层扰动。

blocks.en: 3.1 Typographic + Image-Level Perturbations
blocks.zh: 3.1 字体+图像层扰动

blocks.en: Table 2 summarizes extraction performance for clean and AIRRI-protected documents across all image-to-text systems on both the HE Assignment and 8-and-12 datasets. Results are reported using Character Error Rate (CER) and Word Error Rate (WER), higher values indicate greater extraction difficulty.
blocks.zh: 表2汇总了HE任务和8-12数据集上所有图像到文本系统的清洁和AIRI保护文件的提取性能。 使用字符误差率(CER)和字数误差率(WER)报告结果,较高值表明提取难度较大.

blocks.en: AIRRI increased extraction error rates for EasyOCR and Tesseract. EasyOCR CER increased from 6.9% to 55.9%, while WER increased from 24.9% to 96.7%. Tesseract showed the largest degradation: CER increased from 2.3% to 100% and WER from 10.7% to 100%. This indicates complete extraction failure on all protected documents in the evaluation set.
blocks.zh: AIRRI提高了EasyOCR和宇宙魔方的提取错误率. EasyOCR CER从6.9%增加到55.9%,而WER从24.9%增加到96.7%。 魔方的降解程度最大:CER从2.3%上升到100%,WER从10.7%上升到100%. 这表明评价集中所有受保护文件的提取完全失败。

blocks.en: GOT-OCR2 was less affected by the applied perturbations than some of the other models. CER increased from 30.7% to 48.1%, while WER decreased slightly from 63.3% to 61.9%. Examination of individual assignments showed considerable variation in performance: some protected documents produced substantially higher error rates than their clean counterparts, whereas others produced lower error rates.
blocks.zh: Got-OCR2受到应用扰动的影响比其他一些模型小。 CER从30.7%上升到48.1%,而WER从63.3%略降至61.9%。 对个别任务的审查显示,业绩差异很大:一些受保护的文件产生的差错率大大高于干净的对应文件,而另一些文件产生的差错率较低。

blocks.en: On the 8-and-12 dataset, AIRRI also degraded extraction across all systems. EasyOCR CER increases from 7.3% to 81.1%. GOT-OCR2 showed the largest increase: CER rising from 0.8% to 90.4% and WER from 6.9% to 91.5%. Tesseract CER increased from 1.0% to 38.8%, less degradation than on the HE Assignment, though WER still reached 99.9%.
blocks.zh: 在8-12数据集上,AIRRI还降解了所有系统的提取. EasyOCR CER从7.3%增加到81.1%. Got-OCR2的增幅最大:CER从0.8%上升到90.4%,WER从6.9%上升到91.5%。 易控CER从1.0%上升到38.8%,比HE任务上的降解率要低,尽管WER仍然达到99.9%.

blocks.en: 3.1.1 Individual Image Transformation Performance
blocks.zh: 3.1.1 个人图像转换性能

blocks.en: To evaluate the effectiveness of individual image transformations, each transformation was applied independently at five intensity levels, including a clean baseline (0%) and perturbation strengths of 25%, 50%, 75%, and 100%. The 100% level corresponded either to the maximum supported perturbation value or an empirically selected upper bound intended to avoid excessive visual degradation, whichever was lower. Although stronger perturbations generally led to higher OCR error rates, excessively strong transformations may also reduce human readability. We measured OCR performance at each intensity level and compared it with the clean baseline. Table 3 reports the mean increase in image-to-text error rate across all assignments, perturbation intensity levels, and extraction systems.
blocks.zh: 为了评价单个图像转换的有效性,每次转换在五个强度级别上独立应用,包括一个干净的基线(0%)和扰动强度为25%、50%、75%和100%。 100%的水平要么与最大支持的扰动值相对应,要么与经验性选择的上限值相对应,目的是避免视觉过度退化,以较低者为准。 虽然更强的扰动一般导致OCR误差率较高,但过度强变也可能降低人的可读性. 我们测量了每一强度水平的OCR性能,并将其与干净的基线进行比较。 表3报告所有任务、扰动强度水平和提取系统的图像到文本误差率平均增加。

blocks.en: Table 3 : Mean increase in image-to-text error rate (%) relative to clean images, averaged across all assignments, perturbation intensity levels, and extraction systems.
blocks.zh: 表 3: 相对于清洁图像,图像到文本误差率(%)的平均上升率,在所有任务、扰动强度水平和提取系统中均值上升。

blocks.en: Among the evaluated image transformations, stripe overlays produced the largest degradation in automated text extraction performance, increasing CER by an average of 35.9% and WER by 38.3%. In comparison, opacity jitter and image noise resulted in substantially smaller increases in error rates. Although performance varied across assignments and perturbation intensities, stripe overlays consistently produced the largest increases in both CER and WER.
blocks.zh: 在所评价的图像转换中,条纹叠加在自动文本提取性能中产生最大的降解,使CER平均增加了35.9%,WER增加了38.3%. 相比之下,不透明焦躁和图像噪音导致误差率大幅降低。 虽然任务和扰动强度的性能各不相同,但条纹叠加一直使CER和WER的增加幅度最大。

blocks.en: 3.2 AIRRI Degrades LLM Performance
blocks.zh: 3.2 空气污染 业绩

blocks.en: While CER and WER measure OCR extraction quality, the ultimate objective of AIRRI is to disrupt downstream LLM-assisted assignment completion. Table 4 presents the resulting LLM Performance Score (LPS) and LLM Error Rate (LER) for clean and AIRRI-protected documents. Across all image-to-text systems, AIRRI substantially increased downstream assignment completion failure rates. The aggregate LER increased from 7.4% for clean documents to 55.6% for protected documents, indicating a substantial reduction in the ability of LLMs to successfully complete assignments using extracted text.
blocks.zh: 虽然CER和WER测量OCR提取质量,但AIRRI的最终目标是干扰LLM协助下游任务完成. 表4列出了所得出的LLM性能分数(LPS)和LLM误差率(LER),用于清洁和AIRRI保护的文件。 在所有图像到文本系统中,AIRI大大提高了下游任务完成率。 LER总量从干净文件的7.4%增加到受保护文件的55.6%,这表明LLMS使用提取文本成功完成任务的能力大大降低.

blocks.en: Table 4 : LLM Performance Score (LPS) and LLM Error Rate (LER) for clean and AIRRI-protected documents. Higher LER values indicate stronger resistance to downstream assignment completion.
blocks.zh: 表4:LLM性能分数(LPS)和LLM误差率(LER),用于清洁和AIRI保护的文档. LER值较高表明对下游任务完成的阻力更大。

blocks.en: Tesseract exhibited the largest increase in LER, rising from 5.6% on clean documents to 100.0% on protected documents, consistent with the complete extraction failure observed in the image-to-text evaluation. EasyOCR and GOT-OCR2 demonstrated greater resilience, with LER increasing from 5.6% to 22.2% and from 11.1% to 44.4%. Overall, AIRRI consistently increased failure rates across all evaluated extraction systems, with the strongest effect observed for Tesseract.
blocks.zh: 根据图像到文本评价中观察到的完全提取失败情况,魔方在LER中增幅最大,从干净文件的5.6%上升到受保护文件的100.0%。 EasyOCR和GOT-OCR2表现出更强的复原力,LER从5.6%上升到22.2%,从11.1%上升到44.4%。 总体而言,AIRI在所有经过评价的提取系统中不断提高故障率,对魔方的影响最大。

blocks.en: 3.4 Interviews with Human Readability Experts
blocks.zh: 3.4 与人类可读性专家的访谈

blocks.en: We conducted semi-structured interviews with four domain experts in typography, design, and cognitive psychology. We showed each human readability expert our machine-resistant designs and their perturbation levels. The interviews focused on the designs’ potential effects on reading speed and comprehension across different reading modes, such as interlude reading or skimming. The final part of the interviews covered how the different designs affect neurodivergent readers and future design ideas we should explore. We performed thematic coding to analyze qualitative results from the semi-structured interviews. This effort revealed three codes for creating human-readable perturbations of machine-resistant text: preserving letterform structure, line tracking, and adequate foreground-background contrast.
blocks.zh: 我们在打字、设计和认知心理学方面与四名域专家进行了半结构化的访谈。 我们向每个人的可读性专家展示了我们的耐机设计及其扰动水平。 访谈的重点是设计对不同阅读模式的阅读速度和理解的潜在影响,如间歇阅读或滑稽。 访谈的最后一部分涉及不同的设计如何影响神经潜水器的读者,以及我们应该探讨的未来设计想法。 我们做了专题编码,分析半结构化访谈的质量结果。 这一努力揭示了三种代码,用于创建耐机文本的人类可读扰动:保存字母格式结构,线条跟踪,以及充分的前地-后地对比.

blocks.en: Notably, all experts found the vertical stripes readable. This shows that our most machine-resistant stripe design was the most human-readable, in our experts’ view. Overall, this highlights a primary theme for future work: finding designs that minimally hurt human perception while maximizing degradation of machine perception in image-to-text. For example, all experts found the diagonal stripes unreadable, especially for skimming. P1 remarked they “break up the letterforms”. Thus, this would not be a recommended human-readable design. All experts also found the 50% opacity jitter acceptable, with P2 likening it to a “printer running out ink”.
blocks.zh: 值得注意的是,所有专家都认为纵向条纹可以读取。 这表明,在我们的专家看来,我们最耐机器的条纹设计是最人能读的。 总的来说,这凸显了未来工作的一个主要主题:找到最小程度伤害人类感知的设计,同时在图像到文字中最大限度地降低机器感知. 例如,所有专家都发现对角条纹无法读取,尤其是用于滑行. P1说,他们“打破了字母表”。 因此,这不是推荐的人类可读设计。 所有专家也都认为50%的不透明焦躁是可以接受的,P2将其比作“印刷机用完墨水”。

blocks.en: Future work ideas included experimenting with typefaces that affect vertical text orientation (i.e., mono-type fonts), text over complex backgrounds, varying font types within words (P3 “ransom notes”), and applying opacity jitter only to characters within a word. Notably, all experts urged future work to explore new design ideas as AI technologies evolve and to bridge gaps in optimizing machine resistance while minimally degrading the human readability of AIRRI’s designs.
blocks.zh: 未来的工作构想包括实验影响垂直文字方向的字型(即单型字体),文字超越复杂背景,文字内不同字体类型(P3“ransom note”),并且只对一个字内的字符施加不透明紧张. 特别是,所有专家都敦促今后的工作随着AI技术的发展探索新的设计理念,并缩小在优化机器阻力方面的空白,同时尽量减少AIRRI设计的人的可读性。

blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: 4.1 Adversarial Perturbation Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.1 副扰动分析

blocks.en: ADBA was the strongest attack in our experiments. At ε = 64 / 255 \varepsilon=64/255 , it pushed target-region WER above 70% on both datasets and across all three engines. RayS also degraded recognition with ε \varepsilon , but its peak target-region CER fell short of ADBA’s. On the HE Assignment dataset, Rays reached 25.72% CER on GOT-OCR and 11.44% on EasyOCR; on the 8-and-12 dataset, the values were 23.40% and 9.28%. This gap likely stems from their search strategies: ADBA uses adaptive boundary estimation with offspring sampling to concentrate perturbation energy near the decision boundary [ 9 ] , while Rays relies on random directional search that converges more slowly when the perturbation space is large [ 11 ] . This performance gap aligns with the findings in the original ADBA study [ 9 ] , where ADBA consistently outperformed RayS on ImageNet. Our results indicate that this comparative advantage extends to document images and OCR models, and holds across both datasets. SurFree, the only L 2 L_{2} -bounded attack we tested, failed to produce usable perturbations because the L 2 L_{2} distance between the original and perturbed images exceeded the allowed threshold at all budgets, and is thus omitted from the tables.
blocks.zh: ADBA是我们实验中最强的攻击 在QQ = 64 / 255\ varepsilon = 64/255)时,它将目标区域WER在两个数据集和所有三个引擎上都推高了70%以上. 校对:Soup 在HE分配数据集上,Rays在GOT-OCR上达到25.72%的CER,在EasyOCR上达到11.44%;在8-12数据集上,数值分别为23.40%和9.28%. 这一差距可能源于他们的搜索战略: ADBA使用适应性边界估计与后代采样,将扰动能量集中在决定边界附近[9],而Rays则依赖于随机方向搜索,当扰动空间较大时,会更缓慢地汇合[11]. 这一性能差距与亚行最初的研究结论一致[9],亚行在ImageNet上的表现始终高于RayS. 我们的结果表明,这种比较优势扩展到记录图像和OCR模型,并贯穿两个数据集。 SurFree,我们测试过的唯一L 2 L_{2} 限制攻击, 未能产生可用的扰动, 因为L 2 L_{2} 原始图像和扰动图像之间的距离 超过所有预算允许的阈值,

blocks.en: A notable pattern in Table 6 is GOT-OCR’s high CER on target-region crops at low perturbation budgets (e.g., ε = 8 / 255 \varepsilon=8/255 ): 19.79% on the HE Assignment dataset and 18.91% on the 8-and-12 dataset, compared to roughly 4–6% for EasyOCR and Tesseract on both datasets. GOT-OCR is a vision-language model designed to process full document pages [ 44 ] , and it appears to struggle when given small, isolated line crops that lack the surrounding page context it was trained on. Despite this weaker performance on isolated crops, GOT-OCR’s full-composite CER remains near zero on both datasets, as shown in Table 5 , which indicates the model leverages document-level context to compensate for localized noise. However, this contextual advantage disappears when the evaluation scope is narrowed to the attacked region alone.
blocks.zh: 表6中一个显著的规律是GOT-OCR在低扰动预算下对目标地区作物的高CER(例如,XQ=8/255\varepsilon=8/255):HE分配数据集19.79%,8-12数据集18.91%,而EasyOCR和Contact在两个数据集中的比例约为4-6 %。 Got-OCR是一个视觉语言模型,旨在处理完整文档页面[44],它似乎在给与小的,孤立的线条作物时挣扎,这些作物缺乏它所训练的周围页面背景. GOT-OCR的全复合CER在两个数据集上都保持接近零, 然而,这一背景优势在评价范围缩小到仅攻击地区时就消失了。

blocks.en: 4.2 Image-Level Perturbation Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.2 图像层扰动分析

blocks.en: Across the evaluated dataset, AIRRI consistently increased extraction error rates for EasyOCR and Tesseract, with Tesseract exhibiting complete failure to extract on all protected documents. These findings suggest that the typographic and image-level perturbations employed by AIRRI effectively disrupt the assumptions underlying many traditional image-to-text pipelines [ 42 , 8 ] .
blocks.zh: 在整个评估数据集中,AIRI不断提高EasyOCR和宇宙魔方的提取误差率,宇宙魔方显示在所有受保护的文件中完全无法提取。 这些调查结果表明,AIRI采用的打字和图像层扰动实际上破坏了许多传统图像到文字管道所依据的假设[42,8]。

blocks.en: A notable observation is the difference between traditional image-to-text systems and the transformer-based GOT-OCR2 model [ 44 , 1 ] . While AIRRI substantially degraded the performance of EasyOCR and Tesseract, GOT-OCR2 exhibited greater resistance and more variable behavior. Some assignments experienced increased extraction errors, while others showed improved performance relative to the clean baseline. Notably, its aggregate WER decreased slightly from 63.26% to 61.90%, despite CER increasing substantially from 30.70% to 48.09%. This suggests that AIRRI affects character- and word-level errors differently for GOT-OCR2. One possible explanation is that the perturbations alter segmentation or contextual decoding in ways that reduce some word-level errors while increasing character-level corruption; however, the underlying mechanism was not isolated in our experiments.
blocks.zh: 一个显著的观察是传统图像对文本系统与基于变压器的GOT-OCR2模型[44,1]的区别. 虽然AIRRI大幅度降低了EasyOCR和宇宙魔方的性能,但GOT-OCR2表现出了更大的抵抗力和更多的可变行为. 有些任务遇到更多的提取错误,而另一些任务则显示,相对于清洁基线而言,业绩有所改善。 值得注意的是,尽管CER从30.70%大幅上升至48.09%,但其总的WER从63.26%略降至61.90%。 这表明AIRI对Got-OCR2的字符和字级错误的影响不同. 一种可能的解释是,扰动改变了分割或背景解码,从而减少了某些字数级错误,同时增加了字符级腐败;然而,我们实验中并没有孤立潜在的机制。

blocks.en: 4.3 Individual Image-Level Perturbation Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.3 个人图像层扰动分析

blocks.en: The individual perturbation experiments provide insight into which image-level transformations contribute most strongly to machine resistance. Among the evaluated techniques, stripe overlays consistently produced the largest increases in both CER and WER, substantially outperforming image noise and character opacity variation. These results suggest that structured visual modifications disrupt automated text extraction more effectively than localized pixel-level distortions [ 15 , 26 ] .
blocks.zh: 个别的扰动实验提供了洞察力,说明图像级的转变对机器阻力的贡献最大. 在所评价的技术中,条纹覆盖一直产生CER和WER两种增量最大,大大超过图像噪音和性能不透明的变化。 这些结果表明,结构化的视觉修改会比本地化像素级扭曲[15,26]更有效地干扰自动化文本提取.

blocks.en: Character opacity variation exhibited a different pattern [ 14 ] . Across low and moderate intensity levels, opacity jitter produced relatively little degradation in extraction performance. We observed substantial increases in extraction error only at the highest tested intensity level, suggesting a threshold effect. However, the highest intensity setting also noticeably reduced human readability, reflecting the tradeoff between visual accessibility and text modification documented in readability research [ 43 , 3 , 27 , 30 , 16 ] . As a result, while extreme opacity variation can disrupt automated extraction, it may be less practical than stripe overlays, which achieved substantial degradation without requiring equally aggressive visual distortion.
blocks.zh: 字符不透明变化呈现不同的模式 [14]. 在低度和中度强度水平上,不透明紧张导致提取性能相对较少降解。 我们看到,只有在试验强度最高时,提取误差才大幅度增加,这表明了阈值效应。 然而,最高强度设定也明显降低了人类的可读性,反映了可读性研究中记录的视觉可读性和文本修改之间的权衡[43、3、27、30、16]。 因此,虽然极端不透明度的变异会干扰自动提取,但可能不如条纹叠加实用,它实现了大幅度降解,而不需要同样具有攻击性的视觉扭曲.

blocks.en: Although stripe overlays were the most effective individual transformation, the complete AIRRI pipeline had the greatest degradation in extraction performance. It combines all typographic and image-level perturbations. Thus, AIRRI produced higher error rates than any single transformation alone. This result suggests that different perturbations likely interfere with different stages of the extraction process, and that their combined effects provide stronger protection than isolated modifications.
blocks.zh: 虽然条纹覆盖物是最有效的个体转化,但完整的AIRRI管道在提取性能上的退化最大. 它结合了所有打字和图像层扰动. 因此,AIRI的误差率高于任何单一的转换。 这一结果表明,不同的扰动可能干扰提取过程的不同阶段,其综合效应比孤立的修改提供了更强的保护.

blocks.en: 4.4 Impact on Downstream LLM Performance
blocks.zh: 4.4 对下游LLM的影响 业绩

blocks.en: While CER and WER quantify extraction quality, the LLM evaluation shows that extraction errors do not always translate directly into downstream task failure. Tesseract exhibited complete extraction failure on protected documents, resulting in an LER of 100%. EasyOCR and GOT-OCR2 frequently produced noisy or incomplete extractions that retained sufficient information to reconstruct partial assignments, resulting in lower downstream failure rates. Our findings suggest that extraction-quality metrics alone may not fully capture the practical impact of extraction errors on modern AI-assisted workflows.
blocks.zh: 虽然CER和WER量化提取质量,LLM评价显示提取错误并不总是直接转化为下游任务失败. 宇宙魔方在受保护文件上显示完全提取失败,导致LER为100%. EasyOCR和GOT-OCR2经常产生吵闹或不完全的提取,保留足够的信息来重建部分任务,导致下游故障率降低. 我们的调查结果表明,光是提取质量的衡量标准可能无法充分反映提取错误对现代AI辅助工作流程的实际影响。

blocks.en: Future work could explore human-inspectable AI-assisted workflows [ 45 ] . Although LLMs can often infer missing information and compensate for extraction mistakes, AIRRI increased the aggregate LER from 7.4% to 55.6%, indicating a substantial reduction in successful assignment completion. This demonstrates that sufficiently degraded extractions can still prevent reconstruction of assignment content, suggesting that AIRRI remains effective even against downstream AI-assisted recovery.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作可以探索人工智能辅助工作流程[45]. 虽然LLMS经常可以推断缺失的信息并弥补提取错误,但AIRRI将总的LER从7.4%提高到55.6%,表明成功完成任务的数量大幅下降. 这表明,足够退化的采掘仍然能够防止重新确定分配内容,这表明,即使在AI协助下游恢复的情况下,AIRI仍然有效。

blocks.en: 4.5 Image-Level vs. Adversarial Perturbations
blocks.zh: 4.5 图像级别与破坏性干扰

blocks.en: This section compares the effectiveness and computational characteristics of AIRRI’s image-level and adversarial perturbations. While both approaches aim to degrade automated text extraction, image-level perturbations apply across the entire rendered document, whereas adversarial perturbations introduce bounded pixel-level modifications within selected text regions.
blocks.zh: 本节比较了AIRI图像级别和对抗性扰动的有效性和计算特征。 虽然这两种方法都旨在降解自动文本提取,但图像级别的扰动适用于整个提供的文档,而对抗性的扰动则在选定的文本区域引入有界像素级别的修改。

blocks.en: 4.5.1 Effectiveness Against Image-to-Text Systems
blocks.zh: 4.5.1 对图像到文本系统的有效性

blocks.en: Overall, our results suggest that image-level perturbations provide the strongest protection in our setting. Among the evaluated adversarial methods, ADBA achieved the strongest extraction degradation, particularly at ε = 64 / 255 \varepsilon=64/255 . However, the image-level perturbations generally produced larger and more consistent increases in extraction error across the evaluated image-to-text systems. A notable exception was GOT-OCR2, where ADBA produced higher target-region error rates than those observed under the image-level perturbations. ADBA’s strong performance against GOT-OCR2 suggests that adversarial approaches may offer advantages against more complex image-to-text systems, although additional evaluation of modern vision-language models is needed to confirm this.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,我们的结果表明,图像层面的干扰为我们提供了最强有力的保护。 在所评估的对抗方法中,亚行实现了最强的提取降解,特别是在XQ=64/255\varepsilon=64/255. 然而,图像层的扰动一般使经过评价的图像到文本系统的提取错误增加更大和更一致。 一个显著的例外是GOT-OCR2,ADBA产生的目标区域误差率高于在图像层扰动下观察到的误差率. ADBA对GOT-OCR2的强势表现表明,对抗性做法可能会对更复杂的图像到文字系统提供优势,不过还需要对现代视觉语言模式进行额外的评价来证实这一点。

blocks.en: 4.5.2 Hardware and Deployment Considerations
blocks.zh: 4.5.2 硬件和部署考虑

blocks.en: Image-level perturbations are computationally inexpensive because they are applied directly during rendering. Let n = W ​ H n=WH denote the number of image pixels. Operations such as spacing adjustments, stripe overlays, opacity variation, and image noise require only a single pass over the image and therefore have time complexity O ⁡ ( n ) O(n) .
blocks.zh: 图像层扰动在计算上成本低廉,因为它们是在渲染过程中直接应用的。 让 n = W H n = WH 表示图像像素的数量. 间隔调整,条纹覆盖,不透明变异,图像噪声等操作只需一次通过图像,因此具有时间复杂性 O QQ(n) O(n).

blocks.en: In contrast, decision-based adversarial attacks require repeated queries to the target OCR system. Let q q denote the number of queries. Methods such as RayS [ 11 ] and ADBA [ 9 ] therefore scale as approximately O ⁡ ( q ​ n ) O(qn) , since each query evaluates a perturbed image containing n n pixels. In our experiments, adversarial attacks often required thousands of queries, making them substantially more expensive than image-level perturbations.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,基于决策的对抗攻击需要反复询问目标OCR系统. q 表示查询次数。 因此,RayS [11] 和 ABAA [9] 等方法的尺度约为 O → (q n ) O(qn) ,因为每个查询都评价一个包含n像素的扰动图像. 在我们的实验中,对抗性攻击往往需要上千次询问,使得这些询问比图像层扰动要昂贵得多.

blocks.en: Consequently, image-level and typographic perturbations provide the most practical and scalable approach for educational deployment. This distinction is particularly important for educational settings, where instructors may need to generate protected materials frequently and with minimal computational overhead. For this use case, it is impractical. Because adversarial attacks require substantially greater computation and generation time [ 5 , 10 , 11 , 9 ] , they may be better suited for protecting selected high-value content rather than routine assignment generation.
blocks.zh: 因此,图像级别和印刷扰动为教育部署提供了最实际和可扩展的方法。 这种区别对教育环境特别重要,因为教育教员可能需要经常生成受保护的材料,而且计算费用很少。 对于这个案件来说,这是不切实际的。 由于对抗攻击需要大大延长计算和生成时间[5、10、11、9],因此它们可能更适合保护选定的高价值内容,而不是例行的任务生成。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We present AIRRI, a framework for generating machine-resistant educational content. AIRRI combines typographic perturbations, image-level perturbations, and decision-based adversarial attacks to reduce the effectiveness of automated text extraction systems while preserving access to the underlying instructional material. We evaluated AIRRI using a dataset of higher-education assignments. AIRRI substantially degraded the extraction performance for EasyOCR and Tesseract and produced more variable effects for the transformer-based GOT-OCR2 model. AIRRI also increased downstream assignment completion failure rates; thus, degraded extractions can help reduce the effectiveness of image-to-text-to-LLM workflows. Future work will evaluate AIRRI using formal human-readability studies [ 3 , 35 ] , in-the-wild studies with educators and designers [ 40 , 39 ] , larger educational datasets, datasets across domains like medical texts [ 2 ] , and additional vision-language models to better understand the tradeoff between human usability and machine resistance.
blocks.zh: 我们提出AIRI,这是产生抗机器教育内容的框架。 AIRRI将打字扰动,图像层扰动,以及基于决定的对抗攻击结合起来,以减少自动文本提取系统的有效性,同时保留对基础教学材料的获取. 我们利用高等教育任务数据集对AIRI进行了评估。 AIRRI极大地降低了EasyOCR和宇宙魔方的提取性能,为基于变压器的GOT-OCR2型号产生了更多的可变效果. AIRI还提高了下游任务完成率;因此,退化的提取有助于降低图像到文本到LLM工作流程的有效性。 未来工作将利用正式的人类可读性研究[3,35],与教育工作者和设计师的内在研究[40,39],更大的教育数据集,跨越医学文本等领域的数据集[2],以及更多的视觉语言模型,以更好地理解人类可用性和机器阻力之间的权衡.
